question: What are written representations under SA 580? State the matters on which the auditor should request them from management.

points.label: Meaning
points.description: A written representation is a written statement by management given to the auditor to confirm certain matters or to support other audit evidence.

points.label: Preparation of financial statements
points.description: Management confirms it has fulfilled its responsibility for preparing the financial statements as per the applicable framework, as set out in the terms of the engagement.
points.basis: SA 580, management's responsibilities: preparation of financial statements

points.label: Information provided and transactions recorded
points.description: Management confirms it has given the auditor all relevant information and access agreed in the terms of engagement, and that all transactions are recorded and reflected in the financial statements.
points.basis: SA 580, management's responsibilities: information provided and completeness of transactions

points.label: Form and date
points.description: Representations are in a letter addressed to the auditor, dated as near as practicable to, but not after, the date of the auditor's report.
points.basis: SA 580, date of and period covered by written representations; form

points.label: Not sufficient on their own
points.description: Written representations are necessary audit evidence but do not by themselves give sufficient appropriate evidence about the matters they cover.
points.basis: SA 580, written representations as audit evidence
